# <!--name-->Changelog validate<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Lightweight gate that evaluates whether a PR needs changelog generation. Runs PR-event-specific checks (body-only edits, bot loops) and signals proceed/stop via exit code for the downstream submit workflow.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs
<!--inputs-->
| Name                 | Description                              | Required | Default               |
|----------------------|------------------------------------------|----------|-----------------------|
| `config`             | Path to changelog.yml configuration file | `false`  | `docs/changelog.yml`  |
| `strip-title-prefix` | Remove [Prefix]: from PR titles          | `false`  | `true`                |
| `github-token`       | GitHub token for API access              | `false`  | `${{ github.token }}` |
<!--/inputs-->

## Outputs
<!--outputs-->
| Name     | Description                                                                        |
|----------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `status` | Evaluation result: proceed, no-label, no-title, error, manually-edited, or skipped |
<!--/outputs-->
